claim.purpose: Make cargo-nextest installation immutable and fail closed without cargo-binstall fallback

initial.title: [v0.91.7][ci] Remove cargo-nextest 0.9.140 unsupported-binary fallback
initial.goal: Install cargo-nextest 0.9.140 directly from a supported immutable manifest without fallback.
initial.required_outcome: Every hosted nextest install uses the reviewed manifest, fails closed if unsupported, and emits no cargo-binstall fallback warning.
authority_boundary: Official nextest release assets and install-action manifests are installation authority
Repository CI runtime contracts preserve the canonical pin and fallback policy
initial.task_boundary: Update only nextest installer steps and their static contract, then prove the warning absent on GitHub-hosted CI.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Every nextest install uses an immutable installer manifest that contains nextest 0.9.140 for x86_64 Linux
AC2: Every nextest install sets fallback to none
AC3: Static validation rejects stale pins, floating pins, missing fallback policy, and version drift
AC4: GitHub-hosted CI emits no unsupported-binary or cargo-binstall fallback warning
initial.plan_summary: Pin nextest steps to an installer manifest that supports 0.9.140, disable fallback, strengthen static contracts, and inspect hosted proof.

steps.action: Verify official release asset and supported installer manifest
Update nextest installer pins and enforce fallback none
Run static proof and inspect hosted CI output

risks: A partial update could leave one lane on the stale manifest
A future nextest version could be selected before the pinned manifest supports it
invariants: Every third-party action remains pinned to a 40-hex commit
stop_conditions: The selected official manifest does not contain nextest 0.9.140
The selected action revision requires unrelated workflow changes
review_prompts: Are all nextest install steps updated?
Does every step fail closed instead of falling back?
Does the static contract detect partial or future drift?
Is the hosted warning genuinely absent?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove canonical nextest pin, version, and fallback policy
Prove unsupported-binary and cargo-binstall fallback warnings are absent

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on floating or stale pins, partial replacement, missing fallback none, contract failure, or any hosted fallback warning.
